description_en: You can call the DescribeDBInstanceEncryptionKey operation to check whether disk encryption is enabled for an instance. You can also query details about the keys that are used for disk encryption. This operation is supported for instances that run MySQL, SQL Server, or PostgreSQL
description_zh: 查询RDS实例是否开启了云盘加密，以及密钥详情
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-encryption-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --encryption-key 749c1df7-0000-0000-0000-0000 --target-region-id cn-qingdao --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceEncryptionKey

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在的地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the IDs of instances
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom key
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions接口获取
parameters.name: target_region_id
